frequency_question: What proportion of court-mandated regulatory compliance deadlines result in formal notification and successful judicial acknowledgment within the specified timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes executive or union government actions ordered by a supreme judicial body with a specific short-term reporting date; excludes voluntary rulemakings without immediate judicial oversight.
coverage_note: 5 named cases representing major Supreme Court compliance directives to central ministries.
known_gaps: Limited strictly to high-stakes regulatory mandates involving public health or economic oversight.
skeleton: Regulatory compliance directives with tight judicial deadlines grouped by administrative responsiveness.
validity_reason: Bureaucratic compliance patterns and judicial enforcement mechanisms remain stable over a 3-to-5-year horizon.
